instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/assy.step in BRL-CAD. Use BRL-CAD to read /home/user/Desktop/assy.step, which contains two separated solids. Move the cylinder to the center of the right end face of the block, with the cylinder axis along X, so it connects to the block. Fuse them into a single solid. Cut a through hole of diameter 8 mm along Z at the joint center. The final output must be one fused solid and must not retain separated bodies. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH).
